# FDG3016

> DO use semantically interesting names rather than language-specific keywords for type names.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.2.3 Avoiding Language-Specific Names.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1720
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

CA1720 reports a member or parameter whose whole name is a type name, language-specific or CLR, such as a property Long or Int32 or a parameter double (probe with SDK 10.0.402); a name that only contains one, such as GetInt, is not reported. It is a suggestion because it also reports ordinary words such as Long and Short. Renaming a public member or parameter changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1720 has no code fix.

## From the book

For example, `GetLength` is a better name than `GetInt`.
